scope_summary: 完整移植：分词与搭配词、积分图布局、配色函数、PNG/SVG 渲染、mask 轮廓、CLI；不含 SVG 字体内嵌

story.headline: “我接手了一个 Python + Cython 词云库，发现了 8 个潜伏 bug，在初次 2.9% 的测试失败中自我修复，最终交付了一个比原版快 12.2 倍、与原版逐像素一致的 Rust 移植。”
story.intro: 我把 amueller/word_cloud（1,202 行 Python + 35 行 Cython）完整移植到了 Rust：分词、搭配词检测、积分图布局、配色、PNG/SVG 输出和 CLI 全部覆盖。我用一个 Pillow 字形回放后端证明，除字体光栅化外，整条流水线与原版逐字节一致（60/60 次运行，像素差 0）。端到端运行时间从 3519 ms 降到 289 ms，峰值内存从 83.7 MB 降到 13.6 MB。
story.ch1_narrative: 我先实际运行了原版：75/76 个测试通过（唯一的失败是因为 PATH 环境问题），并测得基线为 3519 ms / 83.7 MB，其中约 300 ms 是导入 matplotlib 的开销。审计中我发现并验证了 8 个潜伏 bug。Cython 内核用 randint(0, hits) 抽取目标位置，goal==0 时永远匹配不到，会在仍有空位时返回 None（空画布上 2000 个种子中有 38 次）。旋转重试永远不会翻回水平方向。uint8 加 mask 会把 255 回绕成 0。CLI 的 --colormap 被静默忽略。ImageColorGenerator 把宽和高用反了。matplotlib 版本号按字符串比较，10.x 会被误判。margin<2 时首行墨迹不被检查。contour 配合 RGBA 模式会直接崩溃。
story.ch2_narrative: 我把 891 行的 wordcloud.py 拆成 22 个职责单一的模块，最大文件 348 行，100% 不超过 400 行。最大嵌套深度从 13 降到 6，平均函数长度从 30 行降到 19 行，注释率从 9.5% 升到 25.1%，并写了 24 个可运行的文档测试。为了逐种子一致，我精确实现了 CPython 的 MT19937（包括 init_by_array 播种和 _randbelow 拒绝采样），用 IndexMap 复现 Python dict 的插入顺序，用 Pillow 的 BLEND/DIV255 整数公式合成像素，并逐行移植了 Pillow 的三遍盒式高斯模糊。字体光栅化抽象成 TextRasterizer trait：生产环境使用纯 Rust 的 ab_glyph，对拍时使用 Pillow 回放。
story.ch3_narrative: 第 1 轮测试有 1/35 失败（2.9%），但错的是我自己写的期望值：手算 Pillow 的模糊半径公式应为 0.25，而不是 0.536，代码本身正确。第 2 轮有 1/71 失败：随机数流在 2 位种子上差 1 ulp。我排查后确认 MT19937 实现没有问题，原因是 serde_json 默认的浮点解析不保证往返精确；开启 float_roundtrip 后，6 个种子全部与 CPython 位级一致。第 3 轮 77/77 全部通过，修复了 2 个 clippy 警告，并补充了朴素内核与优化内核的等价测试和引擎边界测试，行覆盖率从 90.3% 提升到 96.9%（stable 版 Rust 不提供分支覆盖率）。
story.ch4_narrative: 我写了 tools/record_pillow.py：它在原版 Python 运行时拦截 Pillow 的 textbbox/getmask，记录下每一个字形；Rust 通过隐藏参数 --replay-glyphs 回放这些字形。第 1 轮的 60 次运行中有 10 次没有完成，因为我把 900×900 的 mask 和 600×800 的颜色图配在了一起，是 Python 原版自己报错；修正场景后重跑。第 2 轮 60/60 全部逐字节一致：6 个场景（默认、1000×700/400 词、repeat+相对缩放、mask+轮廓、单色+竖排、颜色 mask）× 10 个种子，布局字段完全相等，PNG 像素差为 0。
story.ch5_narrative: 4 级性能阶梯的测量结果：Python 基线 3519 ms，直译版 Rust 3847 ms（比原版还慢 0.91 倍，因为每次测量 bbox 都要完整光栅化字形），SoA + 零分配内核 331 ms（10.6 倍）。这一级的关键改动是：bbox 直接由轮廓计算不再光栅化，积分图原地更新，第二遍查找只扫描一行，再加上一处经过对照测试、由 assert 守卫的 unsafe 边界检查消除（比两种安全写法快 12–15%）。最后用 PGO + Fat LTO 达到 289 ms（12.2 倍），其中 PGO 本身相对纯 LTO 约快 8%，处于测量噪声范围的边缘，我如实记录。三个阶段的输出逐字节相同。

after.unsafe_policy: #![deny(unsafe_code)] crate-wide; 1 audited, benchmark-justified unsafe block (occupancy window counter, assert!-guarded); main.rs forbids unsafe
after.coverage_note: 96.9% is LINE coverage (region 96.3%) from cargo-llvm-cov; branch coverage requires nightly Rust

opportunities.title: randint(0, hits) off-by-one rejects free space
opportunities.description: goal is drawn from [0, hits] inclusive but the second scan only matches goal in 1..hits, so with probability 1/(hits+1) the kernel returns None although space exists, needlessly rotating/shrinking words (verified: 38/2000 seeds on an empty canvas).

opportunities.title: Orientation retry never flips back to horizontal
opportunities.description: 'ROTATE_90 if orientation is None else ROTATE_90' always yields ROTATE_90, so a word that started vertical retries vertical instead of horizontal before shrinking.

opportunities.title: uint8 wraparound when adding mask to canvas
opportunities.description: np.asarray(img_grey) + boolean_mask is uint8: an inked pixel (255) on a masked pixel wraps to 0 and is treated as free space in the integral image (verified 255+True == 0).

opportunities.title: CLI --colormap is silently ignored
opportunities.description: parse_args always sets color_func=random_color_func, and WordCloud ignores colormap when color_func is given, so --colormap never has any effect (verified).

opportunities.title: ImageColorGenerator swaps width and height
opportunities.description: The patch is sliced image[x:x+box[2], y:y+box[3]] — box[2] is the text width but is applied to the row axis — so colours are averaged over a transposed rectangle.

opportunities.title: matplotlib version check by string comparison
opportunities.description: version[0] < '2' and version[2] < '5' selects the legacy 'hsv' colormap for matplotlib 10.x (verified '10.0.0' -> hsv).

opportunities.title: margin < 2 leaves the first ink row/column unchecked
opportunities.description: The occupancy window covers rows (i, i+size] but text is drawn from i + margin//2; with margin 0/1 the first row/col of each word is never checked, allowing overlaps.

opportunities.title: Recursive self-call mutates state to size first word
opportunities.description: generate_from_frequencies calls itself to probe font size, overwriting self.layout_ and consuming RNG draws; the Rust port makes this an explicit pure probe_font_size() step with identical RNG consumption.

opportunities.title: Full scan of all candidate positions per attempt
opportunities.description: Two passes over every (i,j) window per attempt plus a NumPy cumsum re-allocation on every placement; Rust fuses this into a row-major, allocation-free SoA integral update and a single counting pass with early exit on the second scan.

opportunities.title: Font rasterisation is the parity boundary
opportunities.description: Layout depends on Pillow+FreeType+raqm glyph masks; the Rust engine abstracts this behind a TextRasterizer trait (pure-Rust ab_glyph backend + a replay backend fed by Pillow masks for exact A/B verification).

opportunities.title: Dead Python 2 code paths
opportunities.description: sys.version < '3' / unicode checks and from __future__ imports are unreachable on supported Pythons.

opportunities.title: 891-LOC god module
opportunities.description: WordCloud mixes tokenisation config, layout, colouring, raster/SVG export and contours; split into <=400 LOC focused modules.

opportunities.title: contour_width + mode RGBA crashes
opportunities.description: _draw_contour stacks a 3-channel contour and multiplies it with the 4-channel RGBA image, raising a NumPy broadcast ValueError; the Rust port applies the contour to the RGB channels and keeps alpha.

test_iterations.failures_summary: 2.9% failed (1/35 lib tests; cargo stopped before integration/golden/proptest/doc targets): blur_radius_matches_pillow_formula expected 0.536.
test_iterations.fix_applied: Root cause was a wrong expected value in my test, not the code: hand-evaluating Pillow's _gaussian_blur_radius(1, 3 passes) gives sigma2=1/3, L=sqrt(5), l=0, a=0.25. Corrected the expectation; re-ran with --no-fail-fast.

test_iterations.failures_summary: 1.4% failed (1/71): rng_streams_match_cpython - 0.9097462559682401 vs golden 0.90974625596824 (1 ulp). All 24 process_text golden cases (4 corpora x 6 option sets) matched Python exactly incl. dict order.
test_iterations.fix_applied: Diagnosed as the test harness, not the MT19937 port: serde_json's default float parser is not round-trip exact. Enabled serde_json 'float_roundtrip'; all 6 seeds (incl. 2-limb seed 2^40+5 and negative seed) then matched CPython bit-for-bit.

benchmarks.label: 1. Legacy Python + Cython Baseline
benchmarks.notes: python -m wordcloud on examples/alice.txt, 1000x700, max_words=400, median of 5 seeds (0-4), end-to-end incl. interpreter startup (~300ms import overhead). Default 400x200 workload: 704.7ms / 66.7MB.

benchmarks.label: 2. Initial Safe Rust (literal port)
benchmarks.notes: cargo feature 'naive': Cython-style double full scan, NumPy-style allocate+cumsum update, full glyph rasterisation per bbox query. Same workload; median of 10 runs. Note: the ab_glyph rasteriser produces a different (valid) layout than FreeType, so absolute work differs slightly from Python.

benchmarks.label: 3. SoA + zero-alloc kernels
benchmarks.notes: Flat row-major u32 integral updated in place (branch-free per pixel source), per-row hit counts so the second pass touches one row, bbox from outlines without rasterising + bbox memo, one audited unsafe bounds-check elision in the window counter (A/B: ~12-15% faster than safe/zip variants). Output byte-identical to stage 2 for seeds 0-2.

benchmarks.label: 4. Profile-Guided Optimization (PGO) + Fat LTO
benchmarks.notes: -Cprofile-generate -> 15 profiling runs (alice 1000x700 seeds 100-104, constitution rs=0.5, a_new_hope + stormtrooper mask; disjoint from benchmark seeds 0-4) -> rustup llvm-profdata 22.1.6 merge -> -Cprofile-use, lto=fat, codegen-units=1, panic=abort. Mean of 3 alternating medians (10 runs each): PGO 288.8 ms vs LTO-only 312.3 ms (~8%, within container noise of +/-30 ms). Verified: 77/77 tests, 18/18 replay-parity runs, output byte-identical to stage 2.

spotlight.explanation: 核心热点：在积分图上随机挑选一个空闲窗口。Cython 版本关闭了边界检查，每次尝试都要完整扫描两遍画布，而且 randint(0, hits) 存在差一错误。Rust 版本先统计每行的命中数，第二遍只扫描目标所在的那一行；积分图是扁平的 u32 SoA 布局，用 wrapping 运算保持与 uint32 回绕语义一致；legacy_quirks 开关可以选择逐种子复现旧 bug 或修复它。
spotlight.legacy_code:
def query_integral_image(unsigned int[:,:] integral_image, int size_x, int
                         size_y, random_state):
    cdef int x = integral_image.shape[0]
    cdef int y = integral_image.shape[1]
    cdef int area, i, j
    cdef int hits = 0

    # count how many possible locations
    for i in xrange(x - size_x):
        for j in xrange(y - size_y):
            area = integral_image[i, j] + integral_image[i + size_x, j + size_y]
            area -= integral_image[i + size_x, j] + integral_image[i, j + size_y]
            if not area:
                hits += 1
    if not hits:
        # no room left
        return None
    # pick a location at random
    cdef int goal = random_state.randint(0, hits)
    hits = 0
    for i in xrange(x - size_x):
        for j in xrange(y - size_y):
            area = integral_image[i, j] + integral_image[i + size_x, j + size_y]
            area -= integral_image[i + size_x, j] + integral_image[i, j + size_y]
            if not area:
                hits += 1
                if hits == goal:
                    return i, j
